def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    import collections
    seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for si in range(h):
        for sj in range(w):
            if grid[si][sj]==5 and not seen[si][sj]:
                comp=[]; q=collections.deque([(si,sj)]); seen[si][sj]=True
                while q:
                    i,j=q.popleft(); comp.append((i,j))
                    for di,dj in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        a,b=i+di,j+dj
                        if 0<=a<h and 0<=b<w and grid[a][b]==5 and not seen[a][b]:
                            seen[a][b]=True; q.append((a,b))
                top=min(i for i,j in comp); bot=max(i for i,j in comp)
                left=min(j for i,j in comp); right=max(j for i,j in comp)
                # zeros inside bbox
                inside=set((i,j) for i in range(top,bot+1) for j in range(left,right+1) if g[i][j]==0)
                # remove zeros connected to outside via zeros (within bbox or escaping bbox)
                out=set()
                for z in list(inside):
                    if z in out: continue
                    q=collections.deque([z]); grp=set()
                    esc=False
                    while q:
                        x,y=q.popleft()
                        if (x,y) in grp: continue
                        grp.add((x,y))
                        if not(top<=x<=bot and left<=y<=right): esc=True; continue
                        if g[x][y]!=0: continue
                        for dx,dy in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                            q.append((x+dx,y+dy))
                    if esc: out|=grp
                inter=inside-out
                # notch: zero in top row adjacent (below) to interior
                notch=None
                for j in range(left,right+1):
                    if g[top][j]==0 and (top+1,j) in inter:
                        notch=(top,j); break
                for c in inter: g[c[0]][c[1]]=2
                if notch:
                    g[notch[0]][notch[1]]=2
                    ijs=[b for a,b in inter]
                    direction=-1 if notch[1]==max(ijs) else 1
                    jj=notch[1]+direction
                    while 0<=jj<w:
                        g[notch[0]][jj]=2; jj+=direction
    return g
